scheme_name: National Award For Senior Citizens (vayoshreshtha Samman): Best Institution For Providing Services To Senior Citizens And Awareness Generation
other_conditions: The institution must be a registered body in India
Must have at least five years of experience in serving the elderly
Should provide comprehensive services to elderly, preferably in rural or hilly areas, especially to indigent senior citizens
Must have made outstanding contributions and have wide recognition
Should have undertaken specialized or innovative programmes for the betterment of elderly lives
Must have achieved new and effective outreach strategies or programmes
Nominee must be recommended in writing by an authorized person
Open to all Indian institutions, organisations and individuals without discrimination on the basis of religion, race, sex, caste or creed
benefits_summary: Cash prize of ₹5 lakh along with a citation and a memento.
